title: B40 · Half my product demoed as an empty page
anchor: Demo tenant walkthrough, 9 September 2026; maturity markers from the feature inventory of 8 August 2026

slides.headline: HALF MY PRODUCT DEMOED AS AN EMPTY PAGE
slides.sub: I opened the shipping side to show somebody, and it opened on nothing.
slides.boundary: The demo tenant is a parallel empty database. That is the whole reason this happened.

slides.h2: A BLANK SCREEN IS NOT A NEUTRAL SCREEN
lede: The feature worked. It had shipped, it had tests, it ran fifty shipments in 254 seconds the week before.
But the demo tenant is deliberately empty, so what the other person saw was a page with a heading and white space underneath it.
slides.boundary: Nothing was broken. That is what made it worse.

slides.quote: A blank screen does not read as no data. It reads as unfinished.
slides.src: The viewer cannot tell the difference, and they will not ask.
slides.boundary: This is a selling bug, not a rendering bug.

slides.h2: WHAT AN EMPTY STATE OWES THE VIEWER

items.text: Say what lives here in one line
Say why it is empty right now
Show the shape, one sample row, marked as a sample
Give the one action that fills it
Never leave a bare heading over white space

slides.boundary: Sample rows carry a visible sample label so nobody mistakes them for a real order.

left.p: They stop asking about the feature, and they quietly downgrade everything else you showed them.

right.p: They ask how the data gets in, which is the question you actually wanted.

slides.boundary: Same code, same day, different sale.

slides.h2: SO EVERY SURFACE CARRIES ITS STATE
head: Marker
Means
rows: eleven people touch it every working day
no client book on it yet
slides.boundary: Marked on the page itself rather than in a sales deck.

slides.h2: THIS IS NOT A SOFTWARE PROBLEM
lede: Every business has a version of the empty page. The catalogue with no photos on half the items. The quote with a blank lead time. The price list where four rows say call us.
The reader does not read a gap as missing information. They read it as a company that has not finished the job.
slides.boundary: Go and look at the thing you send out most often, and find the blank.

lede: I will walk it with sample data that is labelled as sample data, and tell you which surfaces are load bearing today.

pills.t: No screenshots of a real book

slides.boundary: You will be told what is not handed over yet, before you ask.
